part.text:
Fixed. The issue scenario now outputs `class com.github.javaparser.ast.CompilationUnit` without throwing, and all 18 NodeTest tests (including the 15 `PostOrderIteratorTest` cases) pass.

The fix in javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/Node.java:1169 — `PostOrderIterator.next()` now checks if the stack is empty (root had no children, so `fillStackToLeaf` pushed nothing) and returns the root itself while ending iteration, instead of peeking an empty stack.
